AND dv_reg_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND dv_reg_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( dv_name LIKE CONCAT( '%', REPLACE(#{searchKeyword}, '_', '\\_'), '%' ) ESCAPE '\\' OR dv_addr LIKE CONCAT( '%', REPLACE(#{searchKeyword}, '_', '\\_'), '%' ) ESCAPE '\\' )
